frequency_question: What proportion of active, advanced-stage executive nominations reaching the Senate floor are successfully confirmed via recorded vote before a fixed expiration deadline?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations to Senate-confirmed executive branch positions that were reported out of committee and scheduled for or brought to a floor vote. Excludes withdrawals prior to committee action or purely procedural stall-outs where no vote was ever scheduled.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 named; complete enumeration of all modern Senate-confirmed FDA Commissioner nominees who reached the floor stage.
known_gaps: None for the FDA commissioner subset specifically; broader cabinet posts show minor rejection rates only when severely politically controversial, but floor votes for agency heads once scheduled almost invariably pass.
skeleton: Specific subset of high-level health agency confirmations brought to the Senate floor over 25 years.
multiplier: 7 hits out of 7 advanced floor-bound nominations equals 1.0
validity_reason: Base rate tied to Senate confirmation procedural norms for health agency heads, stable across current and recent political majorities.
